[EN] You sure do know how to sweat a guy. It is, however, gratifying to see one's own work.
[ES] Sabes cómo hacer sudar a alguien. Sin embargo, es gratificante ver el trabajo de uno mismo.

[EN] Hmph... maybe it's not enough.
[ES] Mf... tal vez no sea suficiente.

[EN] There should be some better way.
[ES] Debería haber alguna forma mejor.
